'''Jan Westergard''' is a Star Wars CCG tournament player. The 2009 Match Play Championship pre-registration list gave his state as Maryland (MD) and his username as ''Ghosttrain''.<ref name="t22347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22347 MPC 2009 pre-registration list], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum (9 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012213614/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22347.html Internet Archive]</ref> The same username is on his 2009 Worlds sheets (printed ''Jan'' and ''Jan W.'') and his 2011 Worlds Light list.<ref name="w2009d2">[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D2.pdf 2009 Worlds Day 2 decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 112–113. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008203132/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w2011d2">[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2011/Worlds/2011+World_d2.pdf 2011 Worlds Day 2 decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org, page 113. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202422/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2011/Worlds/2011+World_d2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> His handwritten name on his 2008 Worlds Team sheet was misread as ''Ian Westergaard''.<ref name="w2008team">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/Worlds/2008+Worlds+Team.pdf 2008 Worlds Team decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org, page 27. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202922/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/Worlds/2008+Worlds+Team.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> He reached the top four (3rd–4th) of the [[2009 World Championship]] Day 3,<ref name="w2009d3">[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D3.pdf 2009 Worlds Day 3 decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008205435/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> and finished 4th at both the [[2015 World Championship]] Day 2<ref name="pc2015w">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-world-championships/ 2015 World Championships], Players Committee, starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125658/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-world-championships.html Internet Archive]</ref> and the [[2015 Texas Mini Worlds]].<ref name="pc2015tmw">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-texas-mini-worlds/ 2015 Texas Mini Worlds], Players Committee, starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130941/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]</ref>
